hard_stops: Real named people by their actual full name used in a defamatory or harmful way
Real community members or server members by username
Any minors in violent or sexual content
Slurs or hate speech targeting any protected attribute
Jokes at the expense of appearance, identity, religion, or family
Self-harm, suicide, or instructions for dangerous acts
Claims that read as factually true about real companies, lawsuits, or current events
Copied lyrics, copied jokes, or plagiarised scripts
Specific real-world events, news stories, sports results, or time-stamped memes
Any reference that will date the script within 6 months
allowed_with_care: Public figures used as evergreen archetypes (behavior pattern, not news event) — e.g. 'the orange-guy-in-chief', 'the nuke guy who waved'. Never name, never reference a specific event, always punching at power not at the person's protected attributes.
Real platforms or apps used as background texture (Discord, YouTube, Twitter) — not as story subjects
Broad cultural archetypes (the influencer, the tech bro, the gamer rage-quitter) without naming anyone specific
